decisions.reason: The single-tube condenser draws directly on core condenser know-how and fits the efficiency strategy, but the withdrawal of the related single-tube air fin cooler raises the chance that the single-tube family will be consolidated.

This product is close to the core offer and easy to refine with existing knowledge, yet its overlap with Product B and the pruning of single-tube Product A make it the more likely candidate for consolidation.
The corroded-tube liner strengthens the lifecycle service business, where the installed base and trained technicians provide steady feedback for learning and improvement.
The customized air cooler line embodies the firm's integrated-solutions strategy and rests on deep, broad existing competence across several models.
Tube end repair inserts complement the repair and spare-parts services at low risk, building on proven heat-exchanger knowledge that the firm applies commercially.
